summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0's yellow maze and Level 1's concrete Habitable Zone, with a separate debug room. world.config.yaml wires shared player, camera and HUD behavior; place simulations build encounters and scenery, while player, interaction, combat and loot systems follow players across transitions.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's 56×56-cell maze and hub; authored cells hold props/lights while sim.js generates maze features, loot and encounters.

places/level1 (3D) - Level 1's 30×30-cell Habitable Zone; sim.js seeds the camp, M.E.G. agents, scenery and supplies, and manages Flickering, hounds and stealers; x0z0.scene authors the three named agents.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; cells contain stations, enemy pens, release pads and test objects, and sim.js restores pickups and releases requested enemies.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry with main as default place, player/camera templates, gameplay inputs, lighting, arrival behavior, HUD and nametags.
templates/player.js - ordered player chain: humanoid-locomotion.js, player.js, interact.js, noclip.js, then critter.js.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - custom look-oriented camera; camera script owns yaw/pitch and display-frame camera/viewmodel updates.
places/main/config.yaml + places/main/cells/* - authored 3D Level 0 cells, hub and props; dynamic maze body is generated by places/main/sim.js using scripts/level0-geo.js.
places/level1/config.yaml + places/level1/sim.js - Level 1 configuration and simulation; scripts/look-garage.js gives it the colder, darker garage look.
places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene - authored M.E.G. NPC placements Ale, Callum and Ortiz, using scripts/meg-agent.js behavior.
places/debug/config.yaml + places/debug/cells/* - separate 3D test room with stations, pens, triggers, labels and test objects.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js + scripts/noclip-ui.js - HUD entry, looting/inventory panels and timestamp-driven noclip overlays; world.config.yaml binds inventory to I.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - canonical Level 0 grid, zones, walls, arches, pits, pillars, hub, exit and gameplay tuning; geometry, player/enemy logic and simulation consume them.

scripts/lib/level1.js + scripts/lib/data/level1.yml - deterministic Level 1 grid/zones, room edges and thresholds plus flicker, hound, stealer and supply tuning; geometry, player logic and Level 1 simulation consume it.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - weapon stats, ammo, magazines/reload/ADS/recoil, melee charge and pickup/drop tuning; player, loot, UI, debug and weapon presentation consume it.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js - shared item-token vocabulary and loose pickup/crate/remains creation; Level 1 adds consumables and a distinct crate roll.
scripts/lib/data/meg.yml - M.E.G. NPC health, sight/range, damage, fire cadence, movement, leash and respawn settings; read by meg-agent.js and level1/sim.js.
scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - fitted weapon mesh/fallback presentation for floor pickups, debug stations and player viewmodels; also supplies M.E.G. agents' pistol attachment.
scripts/critter-geo.js - shared procedural critter rig for player avatars, wardrobe and M.E.G. agents; SPECIES is exported for appearance configuration.
mods/modeling-studio/ - integrated creator/modeling tools and HUD, rendered through scripts/ui.js; scripts/lib/plyimport.js handles imported .plymodel conversion/upload.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/level1/sim.js also exports agentSpec.
scripts/lib/maze.js - Level 0 grid/zone/wall/arch/pit/pillar/exit helpers; scripts/lib/level1.js - Level 1 grid, zone, sector, edge, rack, lamp and threshold helpers.
scripts/lib/loot.js - spawnAlmond, spawnWeapon, spawnAmmo, spawnShells, rollWeapon, rollItem, spawnCrate, spawnRemains, dropLoot, rollItemL1, spawnCrateL1; scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - weaponBody.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, takeToken, onInput, reload callbacks, pumpRack, update; scripts/interact.js - onInput, update.

scripts/smilers.js, scripts/lurkers.js, scripts/hounds.js and scripts/stealers.js - update; scripts/level-door.js - onTriggerEnter; scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/critter.js - updateSchedule, blink/twitch callbacks, onInput, update; scripts/critter-geo.js - geometry, skeleton, collider, SPECIES; scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - wardrobe.

scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe; scripts/loot-ui.js - lootUi; scripts/lib/plyimport.js - plyToGlb, plyUpload, with plyUpload re-exported from scripts/ui.js; scripts/noclip-ui.js - noclipUi.
scripts/meg-agent.js - onSpawn, update, vanish; scripts/level1-props-geo.js and scripts/level1-details-geo.js - geometry; scripts/look-garage.js - look.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns persistent progression/XP, HP, sanity, stamina, battery, visited cells/zones, kills/escapes/deaths, weapons/ammo/magazines/equipped weapon and inventory/combat/reload controls; duplicate weapons remain repeated entries in weapons.

scripts/interact.js - player.state focus, lootOpen, lootName, lootList, notice and M.E.G. tip/medic/quartermaster cooldowns; session holds ray/focus scratch; container state.items is its mutable token list.
scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns avatar appearance; outfits stores saved looks and wardrobe controls; mood/blink/twitch, mirror and rebuild scratch are session/local state.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - enemy state.hp/dead and AI prey/mode/gaze fields; per-enemy session carries path, animation and attack scratch.
scripts/hounds.js and scripts/stealers.js - manage tagged Level 1 enemy entities; their hp/xp and stealer revealed state live on entities, while manager session stores prey/roaming/attack scratch.
places/main/sim.js - main place.state owns seed/refill times and per-player shifted-wall timers; generated stairs, shifted walls, loot, crates and enemies are entities.
places/level1/sim.js - Level 1 place.state owns seeded status, puddle/camp state, megGone respawn times, pipe-clang and flicker schedule/phase/timing, and creature refill timers.
scripts/meg-agent.js - agent entity state owns hp, home post, role/name, per-player grudges and talk stamps; session holds target/path, firing, reload and greeting scratch.
flows: world.config.yaml actions/axes → templates/player.js order: humanoid-locomotion.js reads prior movement, player.js writes movement/survival/combat, interact.js handles targeted use, noclip.js timestamps/sounds arrival and exit, critter.js handles avatar input and presentation.
world.config.yaml camera template → scripts/camera.js reads look input and owns yaw/pitch; movement, smiler eye-contact behavior and viewmodel posing consume camera direction/state.

Level 0 exit condition in scripts/player.js → ctx.cross(player, 'level1'); Level 1 BACK trigger → scripts/level-door.js onTriggerEnter → ctx.cross(other, state.to='main'), with transition flash/sound.

interact/reload input → scripts/interact.js focus/container handler → scripts/lib/items.js tokens → scripts/player.js takeToken applies item effects; loose objects are consumed and container state.items is updated.

scripts/interact.js writes focus/lootOpen/lootList/notice → scripts/loot-ui.js via scripts/ui.js renders prompt/menu; menu actions return through loot actions, R takes all, E opens/closes and moving beyond 4.5 m closes.
places/main/sim.js and places/level1/sim.js use scripts/lib/loot.js to seed loot/crates; scripts/player.js dropLoot creates remains for defeated enemies; scripts/interact.js removes emptied remains.

I inventory input → scripts/player.js owns invOpen and handles loot-ui actions: equip, drink, drop (spawns weapon through scripts/lib/loot.js), close; repeated weapon kinds are counted by scripts/loot-ui.js.
wardrobe (C), emote (T), dress action → scripts/critter.js onInput → player.state.look/outfits and creator controls → scripts/wardrobe-ui.js through scripts/ui.js.

scripts/critter.js turns player.state.look into scripts/critter-geo.js params; its procedural rig powers replicated body and local wardrobe mirror; player.js also builds the local critter-fur/sleeve viewmodel arm, or rigs a worn .plymodel's right arm to the weapon grip.
wardrobe model upload → scripts/ui.js plyUpload → scripts/lib/plyimport.js converts/uploads .plymodel → dress modelUrl action → critter.js sets player.modelUrl.

player combat writes HP/sanity/weapons/ammo/ADS/reload and attack markers → scripts/ui.js HUD; attacks target smiler/lurker/hound/stealer/NPC entities; hounds can target NPCs, agents target hounds/stealers or hostile players, and agent deaths are handled by their behavior and Level 1 respawn timer.

Level 1 sim spawns tagged M.E.G. critter NPCs with role/name and pistol; interact.js E-talk updates player healing/supply/tip state and stamps talkAt, while meg-agent.js animates, patrols, fights and respawns them. player.js hits stamp per-player angry state shared across agents; noclip.js writes noclipIn and player.js exitAt → scripts/noclip-ui.js draws timestamp-based overlays.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* authored lights - fluorescent fixtures repeat across maze cells, with red-zone variants; x-1z1's separate flicker-wall uses aged yellow chevron wallpaper, spatial looping buzz/crackle audio and local flicker/light state.

scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/figure-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js, scripts/lurker-geo.js, scripts/stairs-geo.js, scripts/weapon-geo.js, scripts/viewmodel-geo.js, scripts/level0-geo.js and scripts/level1-geo.js - procedural geometry reuses scripts/lib/shapes.js; Level 1's props-geo and details-geo add static camp/clutter and garage detailing.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - parallel Level 0 enemy loops share player targeting, maze path/line checks, bite/death/effect patterns; smilers react to light/eye contact, lurkers to gaze-freeze/sanity.

scripts/hounds.js + scripts/hound-geo.js and scripts/stealers.js + scripts/stealer-geo.js - Level 1 managed threats: hounds hunt players or M.E.G. agents harder in the Flickering and avoid safe corridors; stealers appear as wanderers, reveal near prey, lunge and drain sanity.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js - display-frame camera/viewmodel motion varies by weapon recoil, reload/sight/muzzle positions and melee charge tuning in weapons.yml.

scripts/critter-geo.js - procedural critter rig varies species, sex, body sliders, face/eye/mark choices and clothing/accessory slots; painted face marks use UV decals; its geometry is reused by player avatars, wardrobe and the three M.E.G. agents.
scripts/meg-agent.js - shared behavior for Ale, Ortiz and Callum; role/look and tuning vary per agent, with common pathing, shooting, talking, flinch/death and return-to-post behavior.

scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js - shared item-token vocabulary feeds loose pickups and randomized crate/enemy-remains contents; Level 1 crate weights introduce consumables and its own weapon selection.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; all three places have terrain off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/data/level0.yml are coupled layout/gameplay: Level 0 is 56×56 cells at 4 m each with a 3 m wall and hub cells 26–29; geometry, zones, spawns and AI must stay aligned.

Level 1 has its own independent 30×30 grid at 8 m/cell and 4.2 m height in scripts/lib/level1.js/data/level1.yml; scripts/player.js prefixes its zones with l1_ and suppresses Level 0 hum spikes/dark-figure events there.
Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, noclip.js and critter.js; locomotion reads prior movement before player control writes velocity.

Inventory/container contents are comma-separated item tokens; weapon kinds may repeat in player.state.weapons, and dropping one removes only one copy. scripts/lib/items.js describes tokens and player.js takeToken applies them.

critter-geo.js bone names Tail, Tail1, EarL/EarR and LidL/LidR are shared by jiggle, mood and blink; the first-person critter arm and M.E.G. weapon attachment also rely on critter skeleton hand/bone names.
noclipIn and exitAt are millisecond timestamps in player.state; scripts/noclip-ui.js derives both 7.4 s arrival and 5.2 s exit sequences from them, so keep timestamp writers and UI timing aligned.
